# gouvernance

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-w46-dbs-governs-ai-agents" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-w46/dbs-governs-ai-agents/" data-aixpm-date="2026-11-10" data-aixpm-title="DBS governs its AI agents like a workforce, through an &quot;agentic control plane&quot;." markdown>

**DBS governs its AI agents like a workforce, through an "agentic control plane".** Group CIO Eugene Huang says agents need the equivalent of an employee handbook: DBS runs them inside its internal environment, with controls over identity, authorisation and higher-risk actions, plus human oversight. The bank rolled out an AI credit-assessment tool to about 1,500 employees in August and says it has no plans to shrink its technology team; freed capacity will go to replacing legacy systems earlier. Executive interview, no metrics. [Lianhe Zaobao, 10 Nov 2026](https://www.zaobao.com.sg/en/finance/singapore/dbs-cio-eugene-huang-manage-ai-agents-give-them-employee-handbook)

**PwC Korea reportedly blocks external AI tools after document leaks.** A consultant there says ChatGPT now triggers a "harmful website" warning, after staff uploaded internal documents to external tools. The internal alternative "has the confidence of a partner and the research skills of me on my first day." The cause is relayed as "the explanation making the rounds" and is not confirmed by PwC. [Reddit r/consulting, 9 Nov 2026](https://www.reddit.com/r/consulting/comments/1xre1bw/pwc_korea_blocked_chatgpt_apparently_desk/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-09-insurers-exclude-ai-liability" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-09/insurers-exclude-ai-liability/" data-aixpm-date="2026-09-30" data-aixpm-title="Insurers are starting to exclude AI from corporate liability cover." markdown>

**Insurers are starting to exclude AI from corporate liability cover.** RAND notes that W. R. Berkley has added AI exclusions to its D&O, E&O and fiduciary liability products, and that Verisk/ISO introduced optional exclusions in January 2026. The article's conclusion: uninsurable AI would force corporate customers to delay projects. [The Register, 18 Sep 2026](https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026/09/18/ai-risks-make-some-insurers-wary-of-corporate-liability/5297347)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-human-review-not-control" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/human-review-not-control/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="&quot;Human review&quot; is not a control in an AI risk register." markdown>

**"Human review" is not a control in an AI risk register.** A UK public-sector risk practitioner argues the entry says nothing about what the reviewer can see, verify and stop, citing court cases where a checked AI draft still went out wrong. He would send back any assessment listing it alone, and notes that the verification work lands on a few experienced staff rather than disappearing. [GovInsider, 24 Aug 2026](https://govinsider.asia/intl-en/article/if-your-ai-risk-register-says-human-review-send-it-back)
